Check estimates against the simulation truth

Source: R/sim-tools.R
wgh_truth_check.Rd

Compares child-level estimates (for example individual APHV from a SITAR fit) or population estimates with the true values held in a wgh_sim truth file, and reports bias, root mean squared error, correlation and, when intervals are supplied, coverage.

Usage

wgh_truth_check(
  estimate,
  truth,
  est_col = "estimate",
  truth_col = "truth",
  lo = NULL,
  hi = NULL,
  by = NULL
)

Arguments

estimate

A data frame with pid and an estimate column, or a numeric vector of population estimates.

truth

A data frame with pid and the true value, usually sim$truth_child, or a numeric vector of true values.

est_col, truth_col

Column names of the estimate and the truth.

lo, hi

Optional interval columns in estimate.

by

Optional grouping column present in both (for example sex).

Value

A tibble of recovery statistics.

Examples

sim <- wgh_simulate(1500, seed = 3)
est <- data.frame(pid = sim$truth_child$pid,
                  aphv = sim$truth_child$aphv_true + rnorm(nrow(sim$truth_child), 0, 0.3))
wgh_truth_check(est, sim$truth_child, "aphv", "aphv_true")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 6
#>       n     bias  rmse correlation sd_estimate sd_truth
#>   <int>    <dbl> <dbl>       <dbl>       <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1  1479 -0.00980 0.304       0.986        1.81     1.77
